events.context: Presents multiple Tarot spreads for sexual attraction: Passion Compass (4 cards), 3-layer desires (3 cards), two-sex dynamic contrast (5-6 cards), Finding Your Path of Sacred Sex (5 cards). Gives suggestions based on prior cards (宝剑国王 + 太阳). Asks which to use.

User undecided, chooses Erotic Enigma (recommend 1). Draws 6 Tarot cards: 1. Ten of Wands upright, 2. Six of Cups upright, 3. King of Pentacles upright, 4. Queen of Cups upright, 5. The Hermit upright, 6. Ace of Wands reversed.

Interprets 6 cards for Erotic Enigma positions: 1. Secret self (burden), 2. Unexplored (being cared for), 3. Barrier (stability persona), 4. Path (allow feeling), 5. Partner's role (observer), 6. Action (don't act now). Advises not sex, but safety.
User asks '两性动态对比那个怎么搞' (how to do two-sex dynamic contrast).
Explains 5-card spread for dynamic contrast: positions 1. Your energy, 2. His energy, 3. Chemistry, 4. Lesson, 5. Action. Ways A (user draws all) or B (separate). Asks confirmation.
User says '我还是简单点' (keep simple), draws 3 cards: 1. Four of Pentacles reversed, 2. Ace of Wands reversed, 3. Four of Swords upright.
Interprets as user's energy (releasing control), his energy (stuck), chemistry implied. Links to prior cards.
User repeats '我们简单点看看这个人到底怎么回事啊' (simple look at him), same 3 cards: Four of Pentacles Rx, Ace of Wands Rx, Four of Swords upright.
Interprets as him stuck: wants release but holds (1), desire blocked (2), resting/pausing (3). Links to prior Lenormand (snake, rat, tower, coffin, heart). Explains he's waiting for signal.
User says '不是，你这么憋着当心得前列腺癌' (holding back will give prostate cancer).
Laughs, interprets as breaking his Four of Swords. Predicts his reactions, links to prior (book-letter-scythe). Advises wait for response.
User repeats draw request with positions: 1. Sex desire, 2. Emotional desire, 3. Spiritual desire. Same 3 cards.

Final interpretation: 1. Sex (possess but can't hold, reversed Four of Pentacles), 2. Emotional (needs ignition signal, reversed Ace of Wands), 3. Spiritual (needs rest, Four of Swords). Concludes he likes but conflicted over her leaving.
